overview.summary: An inferred container posture falls back to advisory mode when the default provider has no container-usable credential; doctor predicts it.

stories.name: Inferred posture credential fallback
stories.scope: Downgrade an inferred container posture to advisory mode when the default provider lacks a container-usable credential, keep explicit container.enabled: true fail-closed, and make dartclaw doctor report the same outcome through the single credential-admission rule.
